    <dc:description><B>At the elite Catenan Academy, a young fugitive uncovers layered mysteries and world-changing secrets in this new fantasy series by internationally bestselling author of The Licanius Trilogy, James Islington.</B><BR><B><I>AUDI. VIDE. TACE.</I></B><BR> <BR>The Catenan Republic&#8212;the Hierarchy&#8212;may rule the world now, but they do not know everything.<BR> <BR>I tell them my name is Vis Telimus. I tell them I was orphaned after a tragic accident three years ago, and that good fortune alone has led to my acceptance into their most prestigious school. I tell them that once I graduate, I will gladly join the rest of civilised society in allowing my strength, my drive and my focus&#8212;what they call Will&#8212;to be leeched away and added to the power of those above me, as millions already do. As all must eventually do.<BR> <BR>I tell them that I belong, and they believe me.<BR> <BR>But the truth is that I have been sent to the Academy to find answers. To solve a murder. To...</dc:description>
